7239334.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Wilton

6490794.name: Chabad of Wauwatosa
6490794.note: Its own 'Meet the Shmotkins' page: 'Rabbi Levi & Chani Shmotkin moved to Wauwatosa in July 2024 to establish and open the Wauwatosa Chabad Jewish Community Center'. Earlier note: No start date found: Rabbi Levi Shmotkin's Chabad of Tosa (its site gives no year; no news found). Its chabad.org listing went up Aug 5 2024, so it existed by then. IRS: Chabad Lubavitch Of Wauwatosa Inc, ruling April 2025.

5988088.name: Chabad of Monticello
5988088.note: Its own page (Chabad of Monticello – Chabad of Rock Hill site): 'Rabbi Benzion and Mrs. Chanowitz direct Chabad of Monticello, since they moved in 1994 together'; 'Rabbi Chanowitz's knowledge and Chassidic warmth have maintained Chabad of Monticello over the last two decades'. 5678758.name: Chabad of Wheeling
5678758.note: anash.org, 5 Feb 2023 ('New Shluchim to Wheeling, Illinois'): Rabbi Mendel and Mushky Shmotkin 'are moving to the town of Wheeling, Illinois, to establish the area's first Chabad Center'; 'Throughout their pre-Pesach and Chanuka visits, the Shmotkins have met some Jewish residents'; one of 'the 1,210 new mosdos established for the Rebbe's 120th birthday'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2022-11-08, so the centre existed (as theirs) by Nov 2022, with the Chanukah 2022 visit after it. The Journal & Topics (13 Dec 2023) says it 'was established in the beginning of 2023' (the move). Medium: 2022 (listing and first visit as its shluchim) against the 2023 move. Earlier note: No start date found yet. COLlive (19 Nov 2022), the Merkos grants for new shluchim: 'Rabbi and Mrs. Menachem and Chaya Mushka Shmotkin, Wheeling, IL'. Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 8 2022, so it existed by then.

5525492.name: The Chabad Jewish Center Of FiDi
5525492.note: Rabbi Nissi Eber's own LinkedIn profile: 'Rabbi/Director Chabad Jewish Center of FiDi Jun 2015 - Present'. Its own page: 'After their marriage in 2013, Nissi continued his outreach in the Financial District'; the centre is 'under the auspices of Rabbi Shmaya and Rochel Katz of Chabad of Wall Street'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2022-06-19. Low: one self-reported profile line. Earlier note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, web search). Its chabad.org listing went up 2022-06-19, so it existed by then. Director: Nissi Eber.

118912.name: Chabad Early Learning Center
118912.note: The preschool of the Chabad Center of Northwest NJ (established at the start of 1988). Lubavitch.com, 24 Nov 2005: 'Preschool director Flory Heller' at the groundbreaking of the Educational Center; the Daily Record (CrownHeights.info, 15 Nov 2005): the center had become 'a synagogue, a preschool and a Hebrew school that has already outgrown its 10-year home on Torah Way'. So there by 2005; its start not stated. It moved into the Chabad Educational Center when it opened in the fall of 2008 (its About page). Lead: its chabad.org listing (118912) is from about 2002. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22, so it existed by 2004 (was 'by 2005').

earlier.where: Chabad Center of Northwest NJ, One Torah Way, Rockaway

120058.name: David Hoffman Hebrew School
120058.note: The Hebrew school of the Chabad Center of Northwest NJ (established at the start of 1988; at first the Hersons held Shabbat services and 'eventually classes for children, men and women' in a VFW hall, then from about 1995 in their building on Torah Way). The Daily Record (CrownHeights.info, 15 Nov 2005): 'a Hebrew school that has already outgrown its 10-year home on Torah Way'; Lubavitch.com (24 Nov 2005): 'Hebrew School director Sarah Herson'. So there by 2005; its own start not stated. It moved into the Chabad Educational Center in the fall of 2008. Lead: its chabad.org listing (120058) is from about 2003. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22, so it existed by 2004 (was 'by 2005').

449759.name: Chabad of Tamarac
449759.note: Florida Sunbiz: 'CHABAD OF TAMARAC, INC', document N07000010120 (filed 2007). Start year not found yet; lead: therebbesimpact.com 2003. Its chabad.org listing went up 2006-11-28, so it existed by 2006 (was 'by 2007').

117717.name: Chabad of Penn Wynne
117717.note: The Jewish Exponent (CrownHeights.info, 8 Feb 2007): 'A new Torah scroll was completed recently for Chabad of Penn Wynne'; the procession went from the Kaiserman JCC in Wynnewood 'to the ark at the Chabad House on the corner of Haverford Road and Indian Creek Drive' (Rabbi Zalman Gerber). So it existed by early 2007; its start is not stated. Wikipedia (Penn Wynne; no citation): it started in Rabbi Gerber's house, moved to a storefront on Manoa Road soon after Congregation Beth Hamedrosh moved in across the street in 2007, left it when the lease ended in late May 2010, held Shabbat services in the JCC's Family Hall from 5 June 2010, and from Rosh Hashana (Sept) 2020 has been across City Line Avenue in Overbrook Park (now 7571 Haverford Ave). Rabbi Moshe and Devorah Brennan have directed it since 2011 (its About page). Pennsylvania Department of State record (data.pa.gov, 'Registered Businesses in PA Current by County'): 'Chabad of Penn Wynne Inc.' (filing number 0007313983), created June 25 2021. So the filing is after the listing and is not taken as the year. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22, so it existed by 2004 (was 'by 2007').

117718.name: Va'adah L'dovrei Ivrit Chabad
117718.note: Rabbi Zalman Lipsker's Israeli center (110 S 8th St). Lubavitch.com (23 Sept 2009) calls him 'Director of the Va'adah L'dovrei Ivrit Chabad – Israeli center in Philadelphia', so it existed by 2009. Anash (28 Jan 2025): Rabbi Shneur Zalman and Feiga Lipsker's shlichus in Philadelphia 'began in 1964', at first as teachers in the school, joining Rabbi Avraham Shemtov. When the Israeli center itself began is not found. Pennsylvania Department of State record (data.pa.gov, 'Registered Businesses in PA Current by County'): 'Chabad Israeli Center, Inc and H'vaada L'dovrei Ivrit Chabad' (filing number 0004016111), created Mar 9 2011. So the filing is after the listing and is not taken as the year. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22, so it existed by 2004 (was 'by 2009').

117722.name: Chabad of Scranton

So there by 2008; its start not found. Rabbi Yehuda (Leibel) Itkin was also a contract chaplain at SCI Waymart from 1993 (Pennsylvania Dept. of Corrections, 2023) and is senior rabbi of Ohav Zedek in Scranton. Lead: its chabad.org listing (117722) is from the first batch of listings, about 2000-03. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22, so it existed by 2004 (was 'by 2008').
